verses.1: After Joshua’s death, the children of Israel asked God, “Who will lead us into battle against the Canaanites at the beginning?”
verses.2: And the LORD said to Judah, “Behold, I have given you this land in your hands.”
verses.3: And Yehuda said to his brother Shimeon, “Come with me in my army. Let’s fight against the Canaanites. I will go with you in your army.” And Shimeon went with him.
verses.4: And Judah rose up, and Jehovah gave the Canaanites and the Philistines into their hands. They defeated twelve thousand men.
verses.5: And they found Adonijah in his palace. They fought against him, and they defeated the Canaanites and the Persians.
verses.6: And Adoni-bezek was captured. They pursued him, and they cut off his hands and feet.
verses.7: And Adonijah said, “There are seventy kings with their hands and feet tied. They were captured under my control, just as I did. This pleased God. I brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.”
verses.8: And the Jews fought in Jerusalem. They captured her, and they killed her according to the law of Horov. The city was also set on fire.
verses.9: And after that, the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the mountains, on the hills, and along the plains.
verses.10: And Judah went to the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. The name of Hebron was Kiriath Arba. They attacked Shechem, Ahijam, and Telmay.
verses.11: And he went from there to the inhabitants of Debir. The name of Debir was also mentioned before.
verses.12: And the cat that had eaten the pages of the book, and its lid, said, “I will give him my daughter in marriage.”
verses.13: And Etanael, son of Kenaz, her brother, took the little dog from her. He gave her Akhsah as a wife to him.
verses.14: And when she came out, she tried to get away from her father’s grave. She got off the horse. Then he said to her, “What are you doing?”
verses.15: And she said to him, “May I be blessed, for the land of Negev has been given to me. You have also given me springs of water. The cat gave her its upper springs, and it also gave her its lower springs.”
verses.16: And the sons of Kain gave Moses a gift. They came out of the city of Temarim, along with the children of Yehuda, from the region of Yehuda, which is located on Mount Arד. They went and settled among the people.
verses.17: And Judah went to Shemuel, his brother. They defeated the Canaanites who lived in Caphth. They destroyed that city, and they named it Harma.
verses.18: And Judah took Azah and its borders, and Ashkelon and its borders, as well as Ekeron and its borders.
verses.19: And Jehovah made Israel a kingdom, and he took possession of the mountain. He did not take possession of the inhabitants of the wilderness, because iron chariots were used by them.
verses.20: And they gave the cat its companion, just as Moses had said. From there, Moses took three sons from the serpent.
verses.21: And the Yebusim ruled Jerusalem. They did not replace the descendants of Benjamin. The Yebusim continued to rule over the descendants of Benjamin in Jerusalem until today.
verses.22: And the house of Joseph also went up to the house of El. And Jehovah was with them.
verses.23: And they removed the house of Joseph into the house of El. The name of the city was changed to Luz.
verses.24: And the guards saw a man coming out of the city. They said to him, “Show us the situation of the city, and we will do you a favor.”
verses.25: And he destroyed the gates of the city. He also destroyed the city itself, along with the man and his entire family.
verses.26: And the man went to the land of Hittites. He built a city, and he named it Uz. That is the name it has been called until today.
verses.27: And he did not take away Manasseh’s household, along with their children, and the townspeople who lived there. He also did not take away the people of Dor, along with their children. Nor did he take away the people of Yebelam, along with their children. And he ordered the Canaanites to settle in this land.
verses.28: And when Israel became stronger, they drove out the Canaanites and made them subservient to themselves. They became their rulers, not the other way around.
verses.29: And Efrém did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in that land. Instead, the Canaanites continued to live there.
verses.30: Zebulun did not destroy the inhabitants of Keteron and the inhabitants of Nahalol. The Canaanites remained there.
verses.31: They did not destroy the inhabitants of Akko, nor those living in Zidon. They also did not destroy Achlab, Akzib, Hulba, Afik, and Rechov.
verses.32: And the Asharii sat near the Canaanites, who were the inhabitants of that land. They weren’t descendants of them.
verses.33: Naphthali did not destroy the inhabitants of the House of Light, nor those who lived in the House of Darkness. The Canaanites, along with the inhabitants of the House of Light and the House of Darkness, continued to live there.
verses.34: And the Amorites pressed down the children of Dan on the mountain, because they did not allow them to descend into the valley.
verses.35: And the Amorites were forced to settle in Mount Hermon, in Ayalon and Shalim. The house of Josaphat was also destroyed.
verses.36: And the border of the Amorites is from above the rocks and up from there.
